title: Parking difficulty and park-mode behavior
summary: The topic centers on parking-related difficulty, especially self-parking and vehicle size, alongside several ambiguous mentions of park mode, crowded conditions, inclines, and slow Park-to-Drive shifting.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe self-parking as difficult and the vehicle's extra length as making it harder to park.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention crowded streets, park mode, inclines, crawling-speed maneuvering, and slow shifting without enough context to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence is limited for drawing a clear overall sentiment beyond the few explicit complaints.
This cluster mixes distinct parking-related subjects, including self-parking difficulty, vehicle size, park-mode behavior, inclines, crowded conditions, and shift timing.
Some fragments are too brief or lack outcome context, so they do not clearly indicate whether the experience was positive, negative, or neutral.
